<style>
  #hs-trending-banner-root {
    all: initial;
    display: block;
    position: fixed;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 1999;
  }

  .hs-tb-wrap {
    --hs-footer-max-width: 1392px;
    --hs-nav-left: max(20px, calc((100vw - var(--hs-footer-max-width)) / 2));
    --hs-icon-offset: 13px;
    font-family: "Montserrat", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100vw;
    margin-left: 0;
    background: #F2F4F5;
  }

  .hs-tb-wrap *,
  .hs-tb-wrap *::before,
  .hs-tb-wrap *::after { box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 0 !important; }

  .hs-tb-sr-only {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    padding: 0;
    margin: -1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 0;
  }

  .hs-tb-click-target {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
  }

  .hs-tb-click-target:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid #E03035;
    outline-offset: -2px;
  }



  .hs-tb-bar {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 36px;
    background: #F2F4F5;
  }

  /* Aligns content with the nav while letting the gray bar run full-bleed */
  .hs-tb-inner {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 16px;
  }

  .hs-tb-label {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    height: 36px;
    background: #012B3A;
    border-radius: 0;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    isolation: isolate;
  }

  /* Fixed-width badge; the gray track fills the rest */
  .hs-tb-label::before {
    display: none;
  }

  /* tighter icon spacing */
  .hs-tb-icon-block {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 32px;
    height: 36px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .hs-tb-icon-block svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

  .hs-tb-label-text {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    height: 36px;
    padding: 0 16px 0 6px; /* reduced gap */
  }

  .hs-tb-track {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    background: #F2F4F5;
  }

  .hs-tb-track-inner {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    height: 100%;
    white-space: nowrap;
    animation: hs-tb-scroll 36s linear infinite;
  }

  .hs-tb-track-inner.hs-tb-paused { animation-play-state: paused; }

  .hs-tb-item {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    height: 36px;
    padding: 0 18px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-style: italic;
    color: #012B3A;
  }

  .hs-tb-track::before,
  .hs-tb-track::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 42px;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .hs-tb-track::before {
    left: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, #F2F4F5, rgba(242, 244, 245, 0));
  }

  .hs-tb-track::after {
    right: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(to left, #F2F4F5, rgba(242, 244, 245, 0));
  }

  /* NEW: control sits outside track */
  .hs-tb-powered-inline {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    padding-left: 10px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 1;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .hs-tb-powered-prefix {
    color: rgba(1, 43, 58, 0.78);
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  }

  .hs-tb-powered-logo {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .hs-tb-powered-logo svg {
    height: 10px;
    width: auto;
    display: block;
  }

  .hs-tb-controls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding-left: 12px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 5;
  }

  .hs-tb-toggle {
    width: 26px;
    height: 26px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(1, 43, 58, 0.2);
    border-radius: 0 !important;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
    color: rgba(1, 43, 58, 0.8);
    cursor: pointer;
    opacity: 0.9;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
  }

  .hs-tb-toggle:hover {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    color: #012B3A;
    border-color: rgba(1, 43, 58, 0.35);
  }

  .hs-tb-toggle:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid #E03035;
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }

  .hs-tb-toggle svg { width: 10px; height: 10px; }
  .hs-tb-toggle .hs-tb-play-icon { display: none; }
  .hs-tb-toggle.is-paused .hs-tb-pause-icon { display: none; }
  .hs-tb-toggle.is-paused .hs-tb-play-icon { display: block; }



  @keyframes hs-tb-scroll {
    from { transform: translateX(0); }
    to   { transform: translateX(-50%); }
  }

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .hs-tb-wrap { --hs-nav-left: 12px; --hs-icon-offset: 0px; }
    .hs-tb-bar { height: 36px; }
    .hs-tb-inner {
      padding-left: 0;
      padding-right: 8px;
    }
    .hs-tb-label,
    .hs-tb-label-text,
    .hs-tb-item { height: 36px; }
    .hs-tb-label { font-size: 9px; }
    .hs-tb-label-text {
      display: inline-flex;
      padding: 0 10px 0 4px;
    }
    .hs-tb-icon-block { width: 28px; height: 36px; }
    .hs-tb-icon-block svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
    .hs-tb-label::before {
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
    }
    .hs-tb-item {
      padding: 0 16px;
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    .hs-tb-powered-inline {
